descriptor: Payments and collections for accounts-payable teams

voice.summary: nickel sounds like a sharp finance lead who respects your time. Short, confident sentences promise automation, honest net terms and a real person to talk to.
dos: Name the outcome: payments, terms, collections
Use verbs finance teams use: reconcile, collect, extend
Offer a human option in every flow
donts: Do not use fintech buzzwords like 'disrupt'

boilerplate: nickel is a payments platform that lets businesses run payments, extend net terms and automate collections compliance, with specialist tools for accountants.

microcopy.error: That payment did not go through. Please check the details.
microcopy.empty: No invoices due. All paid up.

logo.note: A coin is a simple nod to the name nickel and to payments.
